name: Outpost Echo
description: A long-abandoned research station whose final expedition disappeared from communication many years ago. The learner's probationary training ground for the whole campaign.

name: The Laboratory
description: A station laboratory containing carefully catalogued but incompletely labelled samples (Mission 9).

name: Communications Terminal / Array
description: A small communications terminal, later a wider communications array, through which recovered expedition logs and a corrupted transmission from Dr. Quinn are restored (Missions 4, 8).

name: The Signal Tower
description: A remaining communications structure, intentionally shut down by the original expedition, requiring a multi-stage engineering repair before it can safely transmit long-range (Mission 15).

name: The Storage Facility
description: A facility blocked by a partially collapsed bridge, believed to hold additional expedition records (Mission 7).

name: Underground Geological Survey Area
description: A previously inaccessible underground survey area revealed once power was restored, containing rock samples, survey maps and unusual geological features (Mission 16).

name: The Observatory
description: A damaged observatory containing unfinished astronomical observations the expedition had been tracking (Mission 12).

name: The Weather Station
description: An intermittently functioning weather station used to compare current observations against archived expedition records (Mission 6).

name: Explorer Academy Headquarters
description: Where the learner receives their invitation at the very start of the campaign (Mission 1) and returns to officially graduate as a fully recognised Explorer (Mission 21).
